scope: CPU-only elimination of zeroed head placeholders and their vector relocation. Reserve blocks+1 and append completed factors in the same block order, then append the same transparent beta. No ciphertext arithmetic, approximation, scales, moduli, key material or accuracy gates change.

policies.0: append_head_factors=false: resize31 then reserve32, overwrite31 leaves, append beta
policies.1: append_head_factors=true (runtime default): reserve32, append31 completed leaves, append beta

build_scope: Normal replay, factor/forest regression and compatibility wrapper compile. Compatibility wrapper is build-only, not a new two-layer precision qualification.
component_protocol: Deterministic full-width coefficient fixtures, no encryption or key generation. N512 columns0/1/4; N16384 columns1/4/7;31leaves plus beta. Both policies compare every stored coefficient to the independent source rows, leaf order, count/capacity, beta position and its zero component. Three warm calls per policy then0/1/1/0 blocks of3 measured calls, six samples per policy/layout. All component processes pin CPU0; construction timing includes initial allocation and append but excludes result comparison/destruction after return. Native repeated in a second process and no-OpenMP build also passes; no-OpenMP retains native instruction selection.
retained_protocol: Two processes; warm preinitialized/appended then measure preinitialized/appended/appended/preinitialized twice per process, eight measured full refreshes per policy overall. Same prepared selector/automorphism/DD caches and retained input; root reuse remains enabled in both policies. getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) immediately surrounds the complete narrow root call, excluding S2C and series evaluation. Builds and unit tests do not overlap timing.
archive_policy: New runtime flag is excluded from the legacy key archive; the zero-row unit fixture compares disabled/enabled archive bytes and verifies loading restores the true default. No keys generated by that fixture.

quiet_repeat_status.reason: Other CPU jobs kept starting;13samples over60seconds failed to find3consecutive quiet samples at5second intervals. The gate launched no benchmark or eight-thread run.

source_work_removed.scope: Source-level payload lengths, not measured DRAM traffic or RSS savings. Final head capacity/count and beta are unchanged.

timing_scope: Head reservation still occurs in input/cache preparation. Appending completed factors is in leaf generation, so first-touch costs may move between these scopes. Only the enclosing refresh scope could establish total gain under stable host conditions. Component minor faults fall substantially, but integrated root faults do not fall proportionately; do not infer the full speedup from page faults.
interpretation: Four-column fresh head construction is about141ms to65ms in both native component processes. All 29 complete output archives match qualified references, and all 9 retained key files are unchanged. Every sampled observation in the first retained pair had other CPU activity, with substantial changing load in the repeat. Observed within-process latency reductions vary about 3.6% to 12.5%; these are contextual observations, not a clean/general full-refresh speedup claim. Original/reduced/default runs qualify correctness only. A clean paired latency comparison remains pending. The 10x goal is not established by these measurements.
